Review on ambiguity cannot flag it: it fires when a class is absorbed into a dominating finding, and spalling is never absorbed into exposed rebar.
rule_that_would_catch_it: Implemented: rust near a spall is exposed rebar and rust with no spall near it is corrosion (the classical segmenter), and review on ambiguity (drishyam/agent.py): when a second class clears A_min mostly inside a finding that dominates it (corrosion inside exposed rebar; crack or efflorescence inside spalling or exposed rebar), the agent keeps one finding and sends it to a person. It cannot catch a spall reported as exposed rebar, because spalling is never absorbed: each case says whether the rule could apply. Not implemented: the shape test (exposed bars as thin strips, minAreaRect aspect above 3) that would keep a rust-stained spall floor as spalling.
